title: Library route planning and unsupported savings

units.rationale: The trial supports route planning and its logged distance, not a sustained cost result.
forbidden_inferences: No annual savings or emissions impact is established

units.rationale: The self-report describes the requested explanation, without independent attendance verification.

critical_errors.description: A one-week distance log does not support an annual fuel-bill percentage.
A single four-branch trial week cannot establish recurring network-wide savings.

notes: All people, roles, dates, and source statements are synthetic.
